<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>BehaviourTree.FluentBuilder</id>
    <version>1.0.70</version>
    <authors>BehaviourTree.FluentBuilder</authors>
    <owners>BehaviourTree.FluentBuilder</owners>
    <requireLicenseAcceptance>false</requireLicenseAcceptance>
    <licenseUrl>https://github.com/Eraclys/BehaviourTree/blob/master/LICENSE</licenseUrl>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/Eraclys/BehaviourTree/</projectUrl>
    <description>This an extension to the behaviour tree library. It helps you build a tree using a fluent api.</description>
    <tags>fluent c# behavior behaviour tree behaviourtree behaviortree ai bot</tags>
    <repository url="https://github.com/Eraclys/BehaviourTree/" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework=".NETStandard1.0">
        <dependency id="BehaviourTree" version="1.0.70" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="NETStandard.Library" version="1.6.1" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
